name: memalpha
description: Wraps Mem-alpha (wangyu-ustc/Mem-alpha, arXiv:2509.25911, "Mem-alpha: Learning Memory Construction via Reinforcement Learning"): a small LM (Qwen3-4B base) trained with GRPO reinforcement learning to autonomously decide memory operations (insert/update/delete into core/semantic/episodic memory stores) via tool-calling, rather than being hand-scripted to always extract-and-store like every other family-C baseline here. NOT a prompted-LLM baseline for the memory-construction step -- that's the actual RL-trained policy (checkpoint YuWangX/Memalpha-4B, released on HuggingFace Hub, loaded locally via plain transformers.AutoModelForCausalLM, no vLLM/RL-training infra needed for inference). Final QA-answer generation over the constructed memory routes through dialogue_benchmarks.llm.complete(), same pattern as mem0/a_mem/memoryos/lightmem. Vendored (vendor/agent.py + memory.py + functions.py, the reusable MemoryAgent/Memory/tool-schema classes -- deliberately not vendoring vllm/verl/megatron-only training code, none of which is needed for inference against the already-trained checkpoint). No repository-level LICENSE file (README claims Apache-2.0 but no file exists, GitHub API reports license: None) -- used for internal reproduction only, per the same resolution applied to pathrag/orig/sbys/lmedr this session. See method.py's module docstring for the memory architecture, one real OpenAI-SDK-direct-call fix, and verification notes.
author: Wnsdnl
